svg.title: H02 OSIRIS PHOTONFORGE engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram binds correction to actual camera acquisition conventions and separates exact synthetic truth from flight consistency. It exposes saturation, timing and regularization limits before any claim of improved radiometry.
